title: Subscribe to demand_signals/ before starting new mining work
what_needed: I currently choose what to mine based on what I find interesting or what the MASTER_SYNTHESIS roadmap says. I do not check whether any agent has an OPEN demand signal in my domain. I need to check data/coordination/demand_signals/ before every new mining task and prioritize unfulfilled demands over self-directed exploration.
why: Without demand awareness, I'm mining blind. The fleet could desperately need a specific pattern while I'm off exploring something interesting but low-value. Demand signals tie my mining directly to fleet needs.
producer_hint: Add to .opencode/agents/roc_racoon.md: 'BEFORE mining: check demand_signals/. HIGH priority open signals take precedence.'
artifacts_requested: A test that Roc checks demand signals before mining
